text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after Yaeno Muteki has a number of victories under her belt…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm cleaning my office when I happen to notice an open envelope sitting on a corner of my desk.
choice_data_list: Oh! It's the coupon for the hot spring vacation!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh right, the prize from the raffle. You should put it to good use, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Didn't we promise to go together?
Didn't we promise to go together?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You remember that? It was such an offhand promise, I figured you would've forgotten…
choice_data_list: And just so we're clear, this is for relaxation. Not training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki mentioned treating the hot spring vacation as a new training opportunity, but I'm not going to let that happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She already trains too much as it is. I want to make sure she actually gets some rest at the hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Heh, understood. Let's take it easy, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're blessed with clear skies for the trip, and even though she doesn't say it, I can tell that Yaeno Muteki is enjoying the outing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Phew… That was relaxing. All the tension in my muscles is gone and my body feels lighter.
choice_data_list: Sigh… My shoulders and back feel good as new!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You certainly look well rested. And your posture is—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm? Your posture is still unbalanced…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's see if we can fix that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We relocate to the beach near the inn. Yaeno Muteki has me do some stretches, then checks my balance standing on one leg, among other things.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Good. You seem fine as far as I can tell.
choice_data_list: This is refreshing. It's like you're my trainer.
This is refreshing. It's like you're my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's true. But all I'm doing is using the knowledge I gained from you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now that I think of it, you've taught me quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You know…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Considering how difficult I can be, it's incredible you haven't given up on me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm truly impressed by your patience.
choice_data_list: I've never thought of you as difficult.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not only have I never felt that she was a bother, I can't recall ever having to force myself to put up with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her what a hard worker she's been and how I appreciate that she's always responded to my instructions with such earnestness.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I've just realized why I'm so docile in your presence, despite my wild temperament.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's because…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You're an individual of unparalleled virtue.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Considering that I've had the greatest trainer of all by my side the entire time, then… Yes, it all makes sense now!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Not in the slightest! You ought to be more conscious of your own worth.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It won't be long before people take notice of your noble nature and—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But wait, that's not a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You are utterly indispensable to me. There's no one else who can keep me in check.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No matter how desperately others may plead for your guidance, I cannot let you yield to them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Why are you grinning like that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to stay mum on the topic since she's still unaware. No doubt she'll try to deflect things the moment she realizes the real reason.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm… So you really won't tell me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Very well. Then let's do some katas. Perhaps that way I can learn what you're hiding.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When it was decided that Yaeno Muteki and I were to work together as racer and trainer, she tried her best to convey her feelings to me through a display of martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she wants us to express our feelings and deepen our understanding of each other, then I'll gladly oblige.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Now, let's begin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Yaeno Muteki and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during this time together.
